ordered_diagnoses: Epithelioid malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor
Sclerosing epithelioid fibrosarcoma with neurofibromatosis type 1 association

s1.syndrome_frame: Recurrent urinary retention and sepsis with diffuse bladder wall thickening
salient_findings: Diffuse irregular polypoid thickening of the entire bladder wall
Near-complete loss of the detrusor muscle
Dense, perivascular spindle cell proliferation with prominent cytological atypia
key_facts: 50-year-old man with known neurofibromatosis type 1
Multiple cutaneous neurofibromas
No history of smoking
Admitted for recurrent urinary retention and sepsis
Transurethral resection of the prostate revealed fibroleiomyomatous hyperplasia
Urinary function did not improve after transurethral resection
CT scan showed diffuse irregular polypoid thickening of the entire bladder wall
Cystoprostatectomy was performed due to compromised bladder function
Bladder wall was diffusely thickened, firm, and gray-white on gross examination
Histologic evaluation revealed diffuse bland spindle cell proliferation
Tumor cells were positive for S100, p16, neurofilaments, and CD56
Tumor cells were negative for pan-cytokeratin, EMA, MDM2, p63, ALK, CD117, DOG1, myogenin, desmin, and smooth muscle actin

shortlist.why_kept: Patient has neurofibromatosis type 1 and the tumor shows spindle cell proliferation with S100 positivity

shortlist.label: Neurofibrosarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Association with neurofibromatosis type 1 and histologic features of spindle cell proliferation

shortlist.label: Epithelioid malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Similar to malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor, with epithelioid features and association with neurofibromatosis type 1

shortlist.label: Sclerosing epithelioid fibrosarcoma with neurofibromatosis type 1 association
shortlist.why_kept: Rare tumor with association with neurofibromatosis type 1, although less likely than malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor

shortlist.label: Malignant solitary fibrous tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Less likely, but still a consideration given the spindle cell morphology and potential for malignant transformation

raw.rationale: The patient has neurofibromatosis type 1 and the tumor cells are positive for S100 and neurofilaments, which are characteristic of nerve sheath tumors. The histologic evaluation also revealed a diffuse bland spindle cell proliferation with cytological atypia, frequent mitoses, and an infiltrative growth pattern, consistent with a malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor.

rejected.label: Neurofibrosarcoma
rejected.why: Neurofibrosarcoma is not a commonly used term and the provided information better fits the diagnosis of a malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor

rejected.label: Epithelioid malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor
rejected.why: The histologic description does not specifically mention epithelioid features

rejected.label: Sclerosing epithelioid fibrosarcoma with neurofibromatosis type 1 association
rejected.why: The tumor's characteristics do not match those of sclerosing epithelioid fibrosarcoma

rejected.label: Malignant solitary fibrous tumor
rejected.why: The immunohistochemical profile and histologic features are not consistent with a malignant solitary fibrous tumor
